schema_description: Living Hearing Profile — sovereign, user-owned, versioned hearing data. Extends openhear-audiogram-v1 with preference, context, haptic and history layers.
subject: Lewis Burgess

clinical_core.comment: Immutable clinical measurements. Append only via history layer; never mutate in place.
clinical_core.source: Dorothy Thomson Hearing Services, 12 Southend Ave, Darlington, DL3 7HL
clinical_core.notes: Most recent verified clinical audiogram. ISQ (no significant change) from prior tests dating back to 2017-01-19.

preference_layer.comment: User-defined loudness and comfort preferences. Evolves over time as the user fine-tunes their experience.

loudness_growth.comment: Per-frequency gain offset applied on top of clinical prescription. Positive = louder, negative = quieter.

context_map.comment: Situational listening presets. Each context overrides specific processing parameters.

haptic_layer.comment: Haptic substitution weights. Higher weight = stronger haptic signal for that sound category. Derived from the audiogram but user-adjustable.

sound_classes.name: voice
sound_classes.note: Speech — most critical category for this profile

sound_classes.name: alarm
sound_classes.note: Safety: maximum haptic at high-frequency alarm band where loss is most severe

sound_classes.name: doorbell
sound_classes.note: High loss at 2 kHz drives strong substitution

sound_classes.name: media
sound_classes.note: General media — user can adjust per preference

history.comment: Append-only change log with SHA-256 content commitments (Burgess Principle compatible). Each entry records what changed and a hash of the profile state at that point.

entries.author: Lewis Burgess
entries.description: Initial profile created from Dorothy Thomson Hearing Services audiogram dated 2021-10-20.

entries.author: Lewis Burgess
entries.description: Added loudness-growth offsets based on six months of real-world listening experience. Slight mid-frequency boost preferred in conversation.

entries.author: Lewis Burgess
entries.description: Added five contextual listening presets. Active context set to quiet_conversation.

entries.author: Lewis Burgess
entries.description: Added severity-weighted haptic substitution map for wristband.
